issues.where: frames 666 to 680 (11.10 s to 11.33 s), globe interior, base, and tabletop
issues.what: at frame 666 the globe is visibly half spring and half winter in one clean frame (pink cherry-blossom storm and pink bokeh above the winter icicle base, lower-glass frost, and white tabletop frost crystal), and by frame 680 the entire base and tabletop surroundings hard-pop in open view to the mossy rock base and scattered pink petals
issues.fix: keep interior, bokeh, base, and tabletop synchronized across the season swap so no clean frame mixes two seasons, and conceal or smoothly transition the base and surface change rather than hard-cutting them in plain sight mid-stroke

issues.where: the arrival across set-B-01.jpg through set-B-06.jpg (frames 720 to 850, 12.00 s to 14.17 s), cherry tree canopy, tulips, and grass bank
issues.what: the spring diorama does not grow in: the full-size cherry blossom canopy and full-height tulip heads are already static in place by 12.00 s behind a receding pink fog veil, and the green grass bank wipes in across the pale ground across frames 760 to 830 beneath already-floating tulips
issues.fix: animate true seasonal growth during the arrival window so turf spreads first, tulips sprout upward from the grass, and blossoms bud and expand outward along bare branches as the storm clears instead of unveiling a static finished model behind fading haze

issues.where: tabletop beneath the lifted base across frames 602 to 718 (10.03 s to 11.97 s) and touchdown at set-B-01.jpg frame 720
issues.what: whenever the globe lifts off the glossy table its mirrored base reflection disappears completely—replaced in frames 680 to 706 by a flat featureless olive-green oval while background bokeh still reflects sharply—then snaps abruptly back on at touchdown (718 to 720); loose winter frost on the table also stays completely frozen during lift and shake
issues.fix: keep the mirror reflection of the base and sphere active throughout lift, strokes, and landing—separating downward and softening slightly with height instead of swapping to a flat green disc—and stir nearby winter frost flecks when the globe lifts and shakes

issues.where: globe trajectory across frames 588 to 718 (9.80 s to 11.97 s)
issues.what: the shake feels light and mechanical rather than heavy in a hand: across 588 to 666 the globe lifts only 3 to 9 px off the table while oscillating evenly at ~2.4 Hz with minimal lagging tilt (~2 to 3 degrees), spikes back out in stroke width at 680 after already damping down, and hovers nearly motionless in mid-air from 692 to 706 (11.53 s to 11.77 s) before floating down to land
issues.fix: lift the globe higher with initial effort, use unequal strokes with sharp reversals and stronger lagging tilt, remove the late stroke jump at 11.33 s and the quarter-second mid-air stall at 11.53 s to 11.77 s, and drop under gravity into a weighted contact settle

issues.where: globe interior across frames 928 to 1294 (15.47 s to 21.57 s)
issues.what: the storm whirl never dies away to a calm rest state: even 9 to 10 seconds after touchdown (frames 1190 to 1294), a dense, non-decaying flurry of large pink petals (~15 to 17% coverage in the open upper-left dome) stays suspended with no visible settling accumulation on the cottage roof or grass
issues.fix: dissipate the post-shake vortex over several seconds so most petals drift downward at varied depths and come to rest on the roof, ground, and collar, leaving only a sparse, gentle ambient drift at rest

issues.where: end of sheet at frame 718 (11.97 s)
issues.what: the sheet stops immediately at touchdown while the globe interior is still an opaque pink whiteout, omitting the clearing that follows
issues.fix: extend the set-A sheet window past landing through the clearing (~15.0 s) so one sheet covers both the whole shake and the clearing that follows

issues.what: the at-rest sheet starts during peak post-shake whiteout (720 to 876) and uses a close-up camera push-in (980 to 1138) that crops off the top third to half of the glass dome across four tiles
issues.fix: sample set-C after the arrival has finished clearing and keep the full globe framed at rest across several seconds
